evidence: Carries the Consensus label and modifies core script execution data structures in src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/script/interpreter.h.
rationale: Eliminating deep byte copies during stack duplication prevents potential memory and CPU inflation if maximum stack element sizes are expanded in future soft forks. The PR addresses a speculative DoS vector for future 10 kB elements that is invalid under current consensus rules, making the underlying problem real to future protocol design but safely deferrable today.
